measure.measure_definition: Body weight measured in kilograms at baseline and week 12. Absolute values, absolute changes and percentage-change contrasts quantify the same clinical quantity; primary ITT weight analysis used multiple imputation for missing data.

Glycated hemoglobin (HbA1c), reported in percent, assessed at baseline and week 12. Secondary available-case analysis without imputation; absolute values and changes quantify the same glycemic measure.

Total daily insulin dose in units/day, recorded from insulin-pump downloads or dose diaries during the 7-day periods before baseline and end-of-study visits. Absolute values, changes, geometric-mean ratios and relative percentage contrasts are distinguished in result rows; secondary available-case analysis without imputation.

population.intervention_regimen: 2.5 mg for 4 weeks, then 5.0 mg for 8 weeks; one participant received 2.5 mg after reducing from 5.0 mg following gastroenteritis; Once-weekly subcutaneous injection for 12 weeks; target dose 5.0 mg after 4-week initiation at 2.5 mg
population.population_definition: Randomized treatment allocation to tirzepatide; primary intention-to-treat weight analysis with multiple imputation.; Adults aged 18–60 years with at least a 2-year history of type 1 diabetes and BMI ≥30 kg/m2; randomized 1:1 to once-weekly subcutaneous tirzepatide or placebo and received at least one dose; included in the primary ITT weight analysis (n = 12 per group) with multiple imputation for missing 12-week weight data.

population.population_time_frame: Randomized and treated between May and December 2024; baseline to 12 weeks

population.population_definition: The 24 participants randomized 1:1 to tirzepatide or matching placebo who received at least one study dose. Adults aged 18–60 years with type 1 diabetes for at least 2 years and BMI ≥30 kg/m2; parent cohort of the two primary ITT weight-analysis arms. Secondary endpoints were analyzed without imputation in the participants with available end-of-treatment measurements.

population.intervention_regimen: Subcutaneous tirzepatide once weekly: 2.5 mg for 4 weeks, 5 mg for 8 weeks. Matching subcutaneous placebo once weekly over 12 weeks.
population.population_definition: Observed secondary outcome analysis in the randomized TIRTLE cohort. Table 2 reports available data for 11 participants per arm for the selected HbA1c and total daily insulin outcomes, analyzed without imputation.
